summary: Focused fix reviewed. The candidate adds liveInputsOnly to the shared checks-read contract, documents that it is advisory-only, and uses it only from the PassLiveInputs fallback. In client-checks.ts the option gates the never-started job reads, workflow-event enrichment and backup-CI stand-ins while exhaustive collection, exact-head binding, strict parsing and status folding stay intact; authoritative CI and merge reads omit the option. Added tests cover the port mode and a 60-record fallback pass over fake ports. No blocking defects found.

evidence: PassLiveInputs.fallback passes liveInputsOnly true to readChecks, so advisory fingerprints no longer pay Actions job reads or backup-CI reads while the step CI gate reads its own full evidence.

client-checks.ts gates neverStartedRunIndexes, enrichCheckEvents and applyBackupCiToChecks behind the option; collection bounds, exact-head binding, strict parsing and headStatuses remain unchanged for both modes.

tests/github/reads-live-input-checks_test.ts asserts two HTTP reads and no job, event or backup reads; tests/repair/loop-live-inputs-checks_test.ts asserts 60 unchanged fallback records take zero job reads while an authoritative read still marks eight never-started jobs.
No throughput threshold is raised: src/host/throughput-watchdog-thresholds.ts is untouched, so the change matches the issue done-when of a focused fallback reduction with fake-port regression tests.
